description:
Nashville-based singer-songwriter Alex Lambert talked with The Current's Morning Show about his song "Think I'm In Love."

Tune in tomorrow Thursday, August 13 at 8:30 am to hear the full interview, and catch Alex Lambert live at Castle Danger Brewery in Two Harbors for The Current Happy Hour Series. 

Find more information at thecurrent.org/happyhours
